title: The Glass Alibi
author: Barış Kısır
premise: Glass artist Mina Hale\'s alibi for the night of the murder is her kiln: the temperature log proves she was firing glass at 2 a.m. But the log is a forgery — she fired the kiln early, at 9 p.m., and the murderer is her sister. To save her sister, Mina must defend a lie in court without breaking the alibi she never had.
